celestrakParity.label: independent raw-vs-fit element-space parity (same NASA ISS OEM, same epoch)

tolerances.note: A2.4: element-space parity vs the SAME-EPOCH CelesTrak ISS-E SupGP OMM (captured 2026-07-13, NORAD 25544, [Segment 01] EPOCH 2026-07-13T12:00:00 == our fit epoch, Δepoch 0s). This is INDEPENDENT raw-vs-fit parity: both we and CelesTrak fit the same NASA public ISS OEM. Observed deltas (our fit vs CelesTrak Segment 01): meanMotion 2.6e-5, eccentricity 4e-7, inclination 0.0008deg, RAAN 0.0005deg, arg-lat(argp+MA) 0.0005deg — tolerances set ~8-100x above observed. RMS: ours 0.080 km vs CelesTrak 0.067 km — the hard beatsCelestrak RMS gate is NOT claimed for ISS; element-space parity above is the honest gate. argp/MA compared as arg-lat (near-circular).
tolerances.rmsGapRootCause: A2.4b CORRECTION: the earlier attribution of the 0.080-vs-0.067 RMS gap to truncated 10-term nutation (~13 m) is WRONG. The OD frame transform now uses the FULL 106-term IAU-1980 nutation series (SOFA/ERFA eraNut80, pinned to <1e-13 rad in test_frame_time_fit), and the ISS fit is BYTE-IDENTICAL before/after the upgrade (same RMS 0.080, same MEAN_MOTION 15.48983449, same INCLINATION 51.6292, same RAAN 169.8717). MEASURED nutation truncation effect: ~0.09 m position at LEO, not 13 m. ROOT CAUSE of the RMS gap is NOT the frame transform at all: an EME2000->TEME nutation/precession error is a near-constant rotation over the 6-12 h fit arc, which SGP4 absorbs into fitted orientation (RAAN/argp/inclination) and does NOT enter the fit position-residual RMS — proven directly: fitting only CelesTrak's 6 h Segment-01 window (12:00-18:00) yields the identical 0.080 RMS as the full 12 h arc, so arc length is not the cause either. The residual ~13 m is a FITTER-CONVERGENCE gap: our Levenberg-Marquardt reaches mean elements within tolerance of CelesTrak's (element parity passes) but a slightly looser position-RMS minimum than CelesTrak's differential correction (0.080 vs 0.067). Closing it is an OD-fitter task (convergence/weighting/element-set search), NOT a frame-transform task, and must preserve Starlink MEME byte-identity. Gate left in honest elementRange state per the A2.4b directive.
